a_stet_registry.where_the_fonts_are: NOT in stet-fonts: the facade crate stet 0.8.4 embeds them. stet/src/embedded_resources.rs ENTRIES = include_bytes! of resources/Font/*.t1 (35 URW programs: NimbusRoman/Sans/SansNarrow/MonoPS, P052, C059, URWBookman, URWGothic, StandardSymbolsPS, D050000L, Z003; PFB-unwrapped Type 1 with binary eexec) plus resources/FontSet/NimbusRoman-Regular-CFF.ps (URW-derived CFF); no build script, no feature flag (always compiled in); register_all puts them in the FileStore as Font/<name>.t1 and resources/Font/<name>.t1. LICENSE-URW-FONTS: the files are the Artifex urw-base35-fonts revisions published under AGPL alone; OFL is stet's inference from URW++'s 2017 Version 2.0 licensing.
a_stet_registry.name_mapping: resources/Init/fontmapping.ps FontSubstitutions (Times-Roman -> NimbusRoman-Regular ...), consumed by fontcategory.ps /FindResource (substitute, FontDirectory, then resources/Font/<name>{.t1,.pfa,.pfb,.ttf,.otf}: Type 1 by `run`, .ttf/.otf by .loadbinaryfontfile reading the DISK only, then system fonts, then DefaultFont /Helvetica), which rewrites /FontName to the requested name; a Rust mirror stet_fonts::FONT_SUBSTITUTIONS (used by .loadfont/findfont native path, font_loader::load_font_file).
a_stet_registry.crates_for_eps_to_pdf: stet (facade, pdf-output), stet-core, stet-engine, stet-ops, stet-fonts, stet-graphics, stet-pdf; NOT stet-render (render feature, tiny-skia fork) and not stet-pdf-reader (dev only). All seven are needed and all must be forked: stet holds the fonts; stet-core must change its hayro-jpeg2000 features; stet-engine/ops/pdf depend on stet-core and stet-graphics on stet-fonts, whose substitution table names the URW files.
a_stet_registry.image_closure: stet-core 0.8.4 depends on hayro-jpeg2000 ^0.3.4 with DEFAULT features (std, simd, image = dep:image + dep:moxcms): this is what put `image` into the shared lock. stet-core and stet-graphics also depend on moxcms 0.8 directly (stet-graphics features any_to_any) - moxcms 0.8.1 is already locked via hayro-interpret (press) and is not a designated crate. jpeg-decoder 0.3 (default-features off) is DCTDecode, needed for JPEG images inside EPS; jpeg-encoder 0.7 ((MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND IJG) only serves the DCTEncode filter (rare in EPS); hayro-jbig2 0.1.0 (+ hayro-ccitt 0.2.0) JBIG2Decode, fax 0.2 CCITTFax, weezl LZW. glob is used only by filenameforall and a Linux SWOP*.icc search. Decision: hayro-jpeg2000 default-features = false, features [std] (JPXDecode kept, no image/moxcms edge); jpeg-encoder and glob dropped; jpeg-decoder kept.

b_fonts.tex_gyre: CTAN package tex-gyre 2.501 (https://ctan.org/pkg/tex-gyre: licence 'The GUST Font License (GFL)'), archive https://mirrors.ctan.org/fonts/tex-gyre.zip sha256 1773c470f9e388e087b68e3426e115af2cd236845a7e05ceb25b2a503409a7a3. GFL = LPPL 1.3c instance (doc/GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt; http://www.gust.org.pl/fonts/licenses/GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt) with a non-binding renaming request for derived works. Each README states the family 'is based on the URW <font> kindly released by URW++ Design and Development Inc. under GFL (independently of the GPL release accompanying Ghostscript)': the publisher's own grant, unlike stet's URW files. LPPL 1.3c (https://www.latex-project.org/lppl/lppl-1-3c/): partial distribution counts as a Derived Work (clause 2) allowed under clause 6 (identify changes, no support implied, point to the complete Work): we ship 33 unmodified .pfb + GUST-FONT-LICENSE + README/MANIFEST and state that in NOTICE/provenance; not copyleft for the rest of the program. Families: Termes=Times, Heros=Helvetica, Heros Condensed=Helvetica-Narrow, Cursor=Courier, Pagella=Palatino, Schola=NewCenturySchlbk, Bonum=Bookman, Adventor=AvantGarde, Chorus=ZapfChancery. TeX Gyre has no Symbol or Dingbats font.
